metadata.description: groundwork - the research pipeline with the stage every other toolkit is missing: one that returns NO-GO, in ten minutes, before the night is spent.

plugins.name: groundwork
plugins.description: Seven gated research stages as skills, each written from a failure that actually happened. The command-line tools (check, cluster, gate, ledger, lit, night, noise, prereg, probe, reach, shard, stats, watch) install separately with `pip install groundwork-research`, and the skills tell you when to reach for each.
